metric: Cases whose table and column lineage match SQLLineage's expected graph exactly. The rest are reported as unknown (22: a SELECT * with no known columns, UPDATE and procedures that are not traced) and none claims a wrong edge.
correctness: 0 cases with an edge or table the expectation does not have (a SELECT * with unknown columns says unknown, not a guess)
caveats: Adapted from SQLLineage's tests (MIT); 253 of the 532 adapted cases are left out because they are not BigQuery SQL (other dialects, lateral column aliases, DROP/RENAME lifecycles). Bugs it found were fixed in the same change, so it is a floor, not a held-out score.
analysis: Column edges: precision 0.993, recall 0.876 (recall counts edges KumoSQL reports as unknown)
